text: The independence of Euclid's parallel postulate was the first clear mathematical independence proof, and its model-theoretic method later served as the template for the independence of the Axiom of Choice and the Continuum Hypothesis.
explanation: True. Building consistent non-Euclidean models (Beltrami, Klein, Poincaré) showed the postulate independent of neutral geometry — the first such proof — and the same 'exhibit a model on each side' method was later used by Gödel and Cohen for AC and CH.
